title: You Can Learn Tokenization End-to-End with Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2602.13940v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Tokenization is a hardcoded compression step which remains in the training pipeline of Large Language Models (LLMs), despite a general trend towards architectures becoming increasingly end-to-end. Prior work has shown promising results at scale in bringing this compression step inside the LLMs' architecture with heuristics to draw token boundaries, and also attempts to learn these token boundaries with straight-through estimates, which treat the problem of drawing discrete token boundaries as a continuous one. We show that these token boundaries can instead be learned using score function estimates, which have tighter theoretical guarantees due to directly optimizing the problem of drawing discrete token boundaries to minimize loss. translated_title: 你可以通过强化学习端到端地学习分词
translated_abstract: arXiv:2602.13940v3 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：分词是大型语言模型（LLM）训练流程中一个硬编码的压缩步骤，尽管架构总体趋势是越来越端到端化。先前的研究表明，在大规模应用中，通过启发式方法将这一压缩步骤引入LLM架构并绘制分词边界具有潜力，同时也有尝试使用直通估计来学习这些分词边界，这种方法将离散分词边界的绘制问题视为连续问题。我们证明，这些分词边界可以通过分数函数估计来学习，由于直接优化离散分词边界的绘制以最小化损失，这种方法具有更严格的理论保证。我们观察到，强化学习中的技术（如时间折扣）对于充分降低分数函数的方差使其可行是必要的。我们证明了...
tldr: 本文提出用强化学习中的分数函数估计和折扣技术，替代直通估计，端到端学习LLM分词边界，以更严格的理论保证最小化损失。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using score function estimation with time discounting from reinforcement learning, replacing straight-through estimates, to learn token boundaries end-to-end in LLMs with tighter theoretical guarantees for loss minimization.
